crossRefs.note: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither…
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”
I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all…
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…
“Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: and Moses gave the redemption-money unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Jehovah, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
